purpose: Authored Chakra reference-to-public-control crosswalk. This documentation is not executable theme configuration or qualification evidence.

reference.palette: Default neutral gray colorPalette in light and dark

authoring.grammar: Finite target/presentation keys bind typed token IDs to fixed public Parts/native helpers. Imported data cannot provide CSS, selectors, properties, HTML or arbitrary role names.
authoring.boundary: Named container style queries select the nearest full data-en-theme boundary, including repeated names; direct rules include matching boundary hosts/native helpers, and auto light/dark follows matching media. Every full boundary reserves --en-theme-companion in container-name; consumer container-name/container declarations must retain it or presentation and nested isolation can fail. No container-type or size containment is added. Full themes reset optional pins; partial overrides preserve unspecified pins.

classificationDefinitions.component-equivalent: Existing component/native helper exposes relevant visual controls; family limits still apply.
classificationDefinitions.adapted-equivalent: Related En Reve component is styled through public controls, with explicit anatomy or behavior differences.
classificationDefinitions.authored-composition: Semantic native markup or existing components can be composed; no dedicated Chakra-equivalent component is claimed.
classificationDefinitions.layout-utility: Consumer-owned layout/position/overflow utility; shared tokens are available.
classificationDefinitions.runtime-utility: Behavior/context/rendering service, outside aesthetic theme compilation.
classificationDefinitions.no-counterpart: No corresponding En Reve component; nearby components must not be presented as feature equivalents.

sourceDefaults.heading: default xl 20px/30px, weight600; 2xl 24px/32px; 4xl 36px/44px with -0.025em tracking
sourceDefaults.font: Inter followed by platform system fallbacks; mono SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Courier New, monospace

adaptationsAndLimits: Three native heading roles map xl/2xl/4xl; this does not add the complete Chakra heading size API.
Font stacks name local fonts; no font download or guarantee of identical glyph metrics.
Native emphasis, HTML heading levels and application paragraph semantics remain authoritative.

sourceDefaults.blockquote: subtle/start: column gap8px, inline20px, start border4px palette.muted; caption14px/20px muted; icon20px
sourceDefaults.list: marker variant: browser list style, fg.subtle markers, optional --list-gap; indicator end gap8px
sourceDefaults.mark: base transparent/inherited color/nowrap; no default variant
sourceDefaults.dataList: md vertical: label muted14px, value14px, root gap16px
sourceDefaults.stat: md: label14px/20px muted, value24px/32px weight600; help12px/16px muted

adaptationsAndLimits: Quote/subtle and prose/content map 20px inline padding,4px muted start border,8px gap and neutral subtle markers through documented helpers; source quotation icons/captions remain authored content.

Description-list/subtle maps14/20px text,normal400 muted labels,4px within-pair/16px between-pair spacing through flat dt/dd; arbitrary multi-term/grouped descriptions and source orientation remain authored composition.
Prose retains its established readable measure,16px outer paragraph/list rhythm and24px list indentation. The source list-gap has no invented default.
Mark/Highlight has no dedicated opt-in helper; arbitrary marked ranges and source variants remain consumer-owned.
Stat has no dedicated label/value/unit/trend slots. Native text can use mapped heading-medium/body/metadata roles; .en-data retains tabular numerals rather than source proportional numerals.

sourceDefaults.kbd: raised/md: mono14px/20px weight500, min20px, inline4px, radius4px, 1px border with2px bottom, word spacing -0.5em
sourceDefaults.codeBlock: md: mono14px with1.625 line height, padding16px, radius8px, border1px, max content320px, header40px

adaptationsAndLimits: Inline code keeps inline-flex; preformatted blocks retain block layout.
Exported codeBlockTemplate supplies an authored label, preformatted code and optional copy callback/button. Its figure/header/pre classes are private pattern bindings, not public companion targets.
The template uses shared space.4, radius.control and color.surface-subtle; its pre uses fixed monospace and inherited size, so font.code does not currently customize that pre.
Source syntax rendering, line numbers, focused/diff lines, toolbar layout and expanding content have no supported template controls.

sourceDefaults.states: solid palette.solid/contrast; hover palette.solid at90%; outline and ghost hover palette.subtle; disabled opacity0.5; duration200ms

adaptationsAndLimits: Primary/secondary/ghost/danger map the four existing En Reve variants; Chakra variant and size APIs are not added.
Source36px small controls remain subject to En Reve minimum target floors, content wrapping and coarse pointer expansion.
Opaque solid hover colors model 90% source paint on the canonical panel; arbitrary backgrounds can produce different composites.
Outline borders use stronger functional boundary colors.

sourceDefaults.default: plain: palette.fg, no rest underline; hover underline at3px offset with currentColor20%; radius2px,gap6px

adaptationsAndLimits: Native anchor navigation, disabled state, focus and consumer-authored link content remain intact.
Link Overlay is an application composition; the theme does not expand click regions over unrelated descendants.
Labels, error visibility, validation announcements and fieldset semantics remain component/application behavior.

sourceDefaults.numberInput: source40px md with24px end control split into stacked steppers
sourceDefaults.pinInput: md40px separate input cells; source shared Input recipe

adaptationsAndLimits: Source1px inside focus is adapted to a2px inset contour; visible-error authority and forced colors remain intact.
Number field keeps horizontal increment/decrement controls and protected target size; it cannot reproduce stacked source steppers through current public Parts.
Native select popup and date/time/password editing UI are platform-owned. Custom Chakra Select is a separate family.
OTP remains one real native input; the theme does not split it into cells or alter composition, paste, selection or autofill.
Textarea keeps rows, resize behavior and content-driven height.

sourceDefaults.paint: unchecked transparent with1px emphasized border; checked solid fill/contrast mark; radio inner contrasting dot at40% scale

adaptationsAndLimits: Control marks can be source-sized while labeled click targets retain En Reve minimums.
Checkbox Card and Radio Card are authored card/choice compositions; no dedicated selected-card recipe/API is introduced.

sourceDefaults.paint: unchecked bg.emphasized track with white thumb; checked palette.solid track with palette.contrast thumb (light white, dark #09090b); shadow.sm;gap10px,label14px weight500;150ms translation
sourceDefaults.visualShadow: The source thumb is scaled80%; the mapped16px thumb uses a dedicated shadow with lengths scaled0.8 to retain the same visual elevation.

adaptationsAndLimits: Transparent retained border and adjusted insets preserve existing switch arithmetic.
Target floors, checked/disabled semantics, RTL and reduced motion remain authoritative.

sourceDefaults.default: outline/md:track8px,thumb20px,border2px palette solid,background fill; range palette solid

adaptationsAndLimits: Public native control supports geometry and accent hooks; independent portable track-fill/outlined-thumb Parts do not exist across engines.
Range slider retains its own two-thumb constraints, keyboard semantics and target floors.

sourceDefaults.default: md20px source stars; palette solid foreground with layered SVG fill and half-value support

adaptationsAndLimits: En Reve uses font-star buttons, clear action and protected targets; no exported filled/half-star Part permits exact layered SVG rendering.
Source separators and moving indicator are not public En Reve anatomy; selected item paint and target floors remain native.

sourceDefaults.customSelect: source custom Select lg48px, distinct from44px NativeSelect

adaptationsAndLimits: En Reve en-select is a native select, not the Chakra custom Select implementation.
Combobox and multiselect retain their own filtering, query, tag and selection semantics; source group/clear/multiple APIs are not added.
Rows retain minimum40px target envelope and protected popup positioning/available-height calculations.
Virtualized measured rows keep their layout geometry; no external margins or source-expansion animation are fabricated.
Source subtle focus boundary is strengthened; disclosure semantics remain native.
En Reve centered/responsive placement, native modality, visible dismiss control and long-title target clearance remain authoritative.
Description uses public Part and inline section padding; optional source composition does not create new slots.
Modal travel is bounded and backdrop shares modal duration; this is not the full Chakra presence/positioning recipe.

sourceDefaults.sections: header24px inline/top16px bottom;body24px inline/8px block;footer24px inline/8px top16px bottom,gap12px;title18/28px weight600

adaptationsAndLimits: Responsive bottom drawers remain viewport-fluid. En Reve bounds travel to8px and shares backdrop timing; no full-distance private transform override.
Sheet receives shared tokens only; it is not a new Chakra Drawer placement API.
Always-present heading/dismiss anatomy remains; source optional header/footer composition has no exact counterpart.
Public width/padding hooks and available-space positioning remain effective; core owns anchored transform.
Mandatory visible title/dismiss action remain; source arbitrary preview composition differs.
Source slide/fade transform remains positioning-core behavior; theme controls timing and surface paint.
Host public overlay paint hooks keep arrow fill coherent. En Reve triangle geometry is not the source rotated square arrow.
Accessible trigger/description association and reduced-motion behavior remain unchanged.
Source8rem surface minimum is not imposed because the owned visual-viewport cap must remain intact and no independent minimum hook exists.
Row target minimums remain40px; public choice/shortcut Parts receive finite styling.
Context menu, menubar and action overflow consume shared menu tokens; their navigation/opening behavior is En Reve behavior.

sourceDefaults.bodyTypography: Inherited default body:16/24px weight400; Card.Description has separate authored typography.

adaptationsAndLimits: Header slot may contain arbitrary title/description markup; no separate title/description Parts permit rewriting consumer typography.
Empty State and card choices are application compositions using these surface and text controls.
Horizontal bottom and vertical logical-end markers use public targets; minimums and content growth stay intact.
Source enclosed/plain variants are not simultaneously applied.

sourceDefaults.collapsible: canonical recipe only overflow and200ms expand/fade; trigger/content are consumer-owned

adaptationsAndLimits: Hidden content and disclosure lifecycle are not overridden with incidental CSS animation.
Collapsible maps to authored disclosure composition; no standalone Chakra component API is introduced.

sourceDefaults.default: plain/md14/20px weight400,gap6px;muted links without restunderline;neutral hover/current;radius2px;separator1em chevron opacity0.8,RTL reversal

adaptationsAndLimits: Authored native links remain consumer-owned when no forwarded link Part is available.
Navigation state and target minimums remain intact.

sourceDefaults.sourceComposition: Pinned basic docs example composes ButtonGroup ghost/sm, current page outline; no standalone pagination theme recipe

adaptationsAndLimits: No public current/uncurrent page Part exposes the source button distinction; inherited button tokens supply geometry and typography.
Responsive chooser, total/status text and protected small targets remain En Reve behavior.

sourceDefaults.default: solid selection/contrast includinghover;subtle range bands withsolid endpoints;todayunderline;navigation/title/day typography frommd recipe

adaptationsAndLimits: Calendar receives day/header/weekday controls and explicit today underline. Date picker forwards fewer Parts, so today/header/weekday details cannot all be specialized through its shell.
Civil dates, locale, keyboard navigation, range constraints and popup target floors remain unchanged.
Native table helper exposes cell padding directly; data-table internal cell directions are not fully forwarded.
Virtualization, sorting, selection and accessible table semantics are not replaced.

sourceDefaults.source: default layout gap16px; source indicators are10px dots

adaptationsAndLimits: Layout gap uses the public measured --en-carousel-gap hook.
Numbered/thumbnail navigation retains accessible labels and target floors; source10px indicators are not substituted for protected controls.

sourceDefaults.default: solid/md:indicator40px circle,2px border,gutter12px,title14px weight500,rootgap16px;current muted withsolidborder;complete solid/contrast

adaptationsAndLimits: Public number/control/label Parts carry proportional40px indices,12px gaps and500 labels.
Current/error tile paint, navigation/disclosure and target floors remain. No public connector or indicator-state anatomy permits exact current/completed circles and connecting lines.
en-progress-step is a display:contents descriptor; the parent owns its visible presentation.
Fallback font scales from inherited UI typography; the complete Chakra discrete avatar-size API is not added.
Application image content, fallback selection and accessible naming stay intact.
Semantic success/warning/danger variants keep their independent status palettes; decorative badge sizing does not shrink interactive controls.
Removable tags retain remove target floors, focus and disabled semantics. Internal .en-tag bindings are not promoted to an undocumented native helper.
Source borderless appearance uses a transparent retained1px boundary so authored border-color hooks remain useful.
Validation summary consumes inherited typography/status tokens; it retains its own links and error navigation.
Success solid uses green700 instead ofgreen600, light warning orange700 instead oforange600 for ordinary white-text contrast; dark warning retains source orange500/black.
Close action keeps protected third column; timeouts, announcements, dismissal and authored general-padding hook remain intact.
Native determinate fill and browser pseudo-element anatomy limit exact range presentation.
Progress Circle has no determinate circular counterpart; Spinner is only an indeterminate alternative.
Reduced-motion behavior and accessible loading announcements remain authoritative.
Pulse applies only with no reduced-motion preference and no forced colors. Source shine/loading-presence APIs are not added.
Status corresponds to the public presence status/indicator Parts; identity/avatar/name and link geometry remain.
Online/busy/offline/away semantic colors and shape cues remain; a generic source status must not erase meaning.
Transparent unboxed entries,24px gaps and public header/author/time typography are mapped.
Feed does not forward generated item Parts; those children receive inherited hooks/type only.
No public connector/indicator/last-item anatomy supports exact source lines. Grouped and virtual pages keep their own structure; no artificial timeline is painted through them.
En Reve color picker is inline; source trigger/popover composition is not added.
Native range thumb paint, gamut/conversion controls and color wheel anatomy remain En Reve behavior.
Swatch is interactive and preserves its target floor and dynamic authored color rather than overriding it with a fixed theme swatch.
Hidden real file-input opacity and browser selection semantics remain intact.
Remove targets stay protected; file previews/sizes and source custom composition are not fabricated.
Token editor is an editing model rather than Chakra list-valued TagsInput; rich-text editor uses the matching public text/control/token surfaces.
Chakra Rich Text Editor is a Tiptap composition, not a pinned core slot recipe. Formatting, selection, composition and undo behavior are not reproduced by theme.
Public base/grip Parts and split-view separator receive finite presentation; resizing grid math, keyboard/RTL constraints and hit targets stay intact.

sourceDefaults.spacing: 4px-based source spacing scale; application layout selects its own dimensions

adaptationsAndLimits: Box/flex/grid/position/aspect/overflow helpers are layout utilities. Shared tokens are available; a theme does not rewrite application layout or add Chakra utility props.
Documented .en-divider maps the source solid/sm1px separator through shared line tokens; no new separator component is created.

sourceDefaults.source: authored icon/image content inherits surrounding color and explicit size

adaptationsAndLimits: Icon artwork and native image sizing remain content/application choices; no Chakra icon package or imagery is bundled.

sourceDefaults.source: behavior/context/composition utilities without a canonical visual recipe

adaptationsAndLimits: Theme tokens and companions do not create runtime providers, client-only rendering, portals, collection loops, download/copy actions, locale formatters or transition lifecycles.

evidencePolicy: Source defaults and authored controls are design mapping. Catalogue/compiler/browser execution receipts, visual comparison and manual acceptance are separate evidence; this file asserts none of those outcomes.
